$comment: Config for the daily DC data-source optimizer agent. Scope = 5 countries. Capped to runBudgetMinutes (< the 120-min GitHub Actions job timeout).

briefing.$comment: DC Audio Briefing is produced/managed by Cowork. Provide its export as a URL or local file via env. Supports .json, .txt/.md transcript, or .vtt captions.

llm.$comment: Optional. If LLM_API_KEY is set the agent uses an OpenAI-compatible / Azure OpenAI chat endpoint to expand candidates and briefing signals. Without it, the agent runs in heuristic (seed-only) mode at zero token cost.

acceptance.$comment: Candidates at or above minConfidence are promoted into data/sources.json under emerging_data_sources. Everything else stays in the candidate backlog for human review.
